said.q: Using a shallow rowboat that had slots in the bottom capable of holding several canvases at once, Monet painted twenty-four pictures of the poplars from his floating studio. The resulting paintings reflect the view at different seasons and times of day and were known as the Poplar Series when they were exhibited in February 1892.
said.by: Philadelphia Museum of Art, on Artsy

events.q: In the summer of 1891, Monet began to paint a row of poplar trees that lined the river Epte near his house at Giverny.
The resulting paintings reflect the view at different seasons and times of day and were known as the Poplar Series when they were exhibited in February 1892.
